integrity_statement: The claim relies on a supplied exact-rational exhaustive certificate with a proved projection and symmetry reduction. Historical priority is provisional. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: An exact finite enumeration for marked genuine four-simplices in the Boolean four-cube only; not an asymptotic or general-dimension theorem. Novelty is the second distance and three near-extremal symmetry orbits, not the previously known minimum.
title: A sharp first stability gap for vertex–tetrahedron distances in the Boolean four-cube
